notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0s
notes.notes:
This hotfix is mostly related to an issue on Steamdeck where player input had issues; that should all be fixed now. We also made a minor tweak to the credits screen, which wasn't scrollable. 

Thanks to everyone who helped report issues and test stuff for us; we'll be back in time for the Steam summer sale with a new bonus event, a movie starring Cath called Wolf Instinct.

- Fixed (finally) an issue with text input on Steamdeck.
- Fixed credits not being fully scrollable when opening for the first time

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0L

notes.title: Paradise Lust 2 hits full release May 15
notes.notes:
After a year or so in Early Access and over a dozen updates, Paradise Lust 2 is finally heading for full release on May 15. 

Mark your calendars. The final update includes completed storylines, new scenes, and the last batch of polish we’ve been holding back to make sure nothing explodes on launch. Sorry for the wait, finishing a game this size while keeping things monthly has been a balancing act, but we wanted to get it right.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/be77ff77185b0874bad40b1b54e2b842aada6da3.gif

If you’ve been waiting for the whole thing to land before playing, now’s your chance. Everything will be in, start to finish.

We’ll post a full breakdown of what’s in the update closer on launch day. 

And yes! Paradise Lust 3 is already in the works. In fact, the Steam page just went live.
Big cast, bigger drama, and a certain pageant making a return.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616780/Paradise_Lust_3/

See you all on May 15. Thank you for your support and the wait!
--

Join our Discord or Reddit to talk about it, we’re always lurking and open to your feedback and suggestions.
